summary: Entegris filed a routine 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable November 18, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business October 28, 2026. No special-situation transaction, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is involved. The filing satisfies ordinary current-report obligations and attaches the related news release as Exhibit 99.1. This is a capital-return event, not an acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private or activist matter, so the special-situations categorization is None. Watch for ordinary ex-dividend trading adjustments around the record and payment dates.
